[i]بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
בשם אלוהים הרחמן הרחום[/i]

We agree with the statement by Mizrahel regarding the situation in Maarav, though we do warn against military intervention there unless there is solid evidence that the people there are being religiously persecuted and there is no other option to end their persecution. It is the right of all indigenous people to have sovereignty over their land, and for too long now, Shamat has seen foreign countries occupy nations or part of nations to prevent terrorism or establish security. The nations of Shamat are capable of fighting terrorism and establishing our own security. We call upon Thyven, as well as the Republic of Bob and Vespurias to give back full control of Sal Baliz to the government there, and for Thyven to allow the people of Maarav to hold a referendum on independence. In shaa Allah this can be done peacefully.

As an aside, we wish to establish diplomatic relations with Mizrahel, as with all nations on the Shamats. While we are a Muslim majority country, we have no issue with other religions, and have a Jewish population of nearly 2 million people who are full citizens with all the same rights as everyone else. There are 1,500 Jewish schools and 50 Jewish seminaries in our country, as well as 2,500 synagogues and temples in Baladullah. In shaa Allah we can have peaceful relations.

[i]Sultan Masud al-Ayyubi
Foreign Minister Abdoul Mahonomayi
Defense Minister Musa al-Yahudiyyah
Chief Rabbi of Baladullah Yacob ben Atzili [/i]
[/spoiler]

[quote=qianxun;60801261][b]Kosmopolitês[/b], by Argo Lo Pilato

To say that certain philosophies ought to be intertwined with a national character suggests that there must be an end to human thought, that at the borderline of the idea is a vast sea navigable only to the nation at the far end of the world. Philosophy has no nationality, and consequently philosophers are the citizens of the world, [i]kosmopolitês[/i].

Communism is based upon a view that all history has been subjected to conflict over resources, in the struggle of the classes. Here is labor, which is weaponzed by the kings and the bourgeoisie as a tool to extract the highest possible wealth at the expense of the proletariat.

Shall we say that the notion of a proletariat is a Sanguinian idea, for the [i]proletarii[/i] were first manifest through writings in their land? Or, should we ascribe the concept of the class conflict as an entirely Hochdeutsch phenomenon during the struggles of the Arbeit-Sozialbund? Or that the people's struggle ought to be considered a Qianxun fabrication created through the works of Dai Jun? Are the attempts to mend socialism and Christianity a Thyvenic creation?

That imperialists continue to contend that communism is a "foreign" ideology imported over to devastate the peoples of Erene is itself the highest imperialism. It is the same mechanism upon which the Old Order contended notions of freedom and democracy to be innovations of the white man alone, which must be imposed upon the Shamatines and Argossians lest they fall back into the tyranny of a benighted age.

Mizrahel has opted to side with this imperialistic acquisition of intellectual thought. By its own greed, it hoards for itself the notion of a homeland for the Jewish people and disposes communism as an Elseyran export to proclaim Maarav an occupied state. What differentiates colonialism from the workers' revolution? Whether what follows is the dictatorship of the bourgeoisie or the dictatorship of the proletariat, the parasitism of capitalist production or supreme reorganization through the soviets.

However, the neo-fascist, ethnonationalist, and totalitarian militarism of the Mizrahelis cannot triumph over the freedom of the Maarav, for communism has no nationality. The [i]shofetim[/i] are an ancient manifestation of the communitarian roots already known to the Ma'arav. That this body had been enlightened to the historical materialistic lens of our history is, therefore, not imperialism, when by their own local agency they had been permitted to assemble their own soviets that shall function as autonomous sections of an International.

[nation]Mizrahel[/nation]
[nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation][/quote]

The Sikirski delegation already has many ideas on the topic, but we still wish to secure a positive outcome, at best.

We encourage all nations to come to the table.

[quote=lusandrism;60800491][spoiler=[b]Tallislandic Eclipse[/b]]

The capture of the Office of the Navy, despite how much life it cost and the little equipment seized, proved to be a great disaster to the Principalist government, who lost countless records, classified documents, etc stored in the facility as well as the flagship carrier of the Tallislandic fleet. Even worse, following the seizure the head of the Tallislandic navy Admiral Augustus Sikorski broke out of Radicalist captivity and escaped to the island of Tylerek, from where he declared himself Regent of the Kingdom of Szbulba and Emperor of the White Sea.

Despite his apparent madness, Sikorski garnered much support among those in the Navy who were already unconvinced of Principalist rule, and even more amongst seamen and sailors who were of Szbulban and Rechite heritage. Donning their own flag resembling that of the Pre-1800 subjugation of Szbulba by Tallisland, Sikorski has claimed loyalty not to the Principalists or Anti-Principalists, but to himself alone.

Given the Szbulban's proud history of pilfering and raiding the straits of the White Sea, some Tallislandics (especially those in the cabinet of the Holy President) have expressed that these heretics will bring about a return of piracy in the White Sea under their fake kingdom. 

Sikorski, from a villa on Tylerek, would begin the command of his fleet, of his people. Naval leadership of Tallisland followed Sikorski to Tylerek, including 3 submarines, 9 mine warfare vessels, 11 cruisers, 7 frigates, 6 destroyers, 20 corvettes, and 3 patrol boats. Now calling himself Emperor Augustus the Excellent of the White Sea, he renamed each vessel to have Szbulban names, and forced them to use the Szbulban naval banners.

Augustus now wielded a total of 56 vessels, which he intended to use as a means to push both the EDU and THEP out of his country's sovereign seas. Emperor Augustus would attempt to contact the fleet of the Neue Republik, requesting that they retreat their soldiers from the White Sea Islands and leave Tallislandic-now Szbulban seas. 

Being fair to all sides involved, the Kingdom of Szbulba too demanded the AWN withdraw from their sovereign territory and leave Szbulban waters, radioing to THEP forces to demand the same.

Stennes dumped the rest of the magazine into the corpse, saving the final round to shoot the body-double. Kjersti tossed the gun onto the double's corpse, and drove away. 

Watt's Loyalists officially split the next day, when he learned that the double had been killed. Claiming leadership of the Commune of Tallisland, he gained much support from the rural parts of Rechia, and those more skeptical of some of the more racialist elements of Stennes rebellion. With many socialist revolutions occuring worldwide, he too banked on those that supported those rebellions coming to his aid. 

At first, many were reluctant to fight against those who had protested and even occasionally fought alongside them, many first demanding the enemy loyalists run away, beating, apprehending, or even hesitantly killing those that refused. To their reluctance, Watts emphasized that these traitors must be killed for true freedom to be brought to Tallisland.

The civil war progressed immensely, with the Anti-Principalists gaining much ground, even despite being severed from the AWN support in the south. Their attempts to cross the Szbulban Sea was almost completely halted by the strong Republik defense, killing thousands in their repetitive naval assaults.

By the time the legislative/judicial capital of Kranowo nad Bridgenay fell, opposition leader Finley Gallagher had finally gathered enough supporters to begin a vote of no confidence in Holy President Clifford Prisk's ability to protect and maintain the Holy Republic. His reign was coming to a close, no doubt, and it wouldn't be long before he would have to face his demons and suffer for his crimes.

Holy President Clifford Prisk and his closest followers had received information from meteorologists that a gargantuan earthquake was inbound to Tallisland by December, and purposefully withheld the information from those that did not support him. He still had support in Tel Karmiw, or if he didn't, he could hide out there.

President Prisk, Vice President Krzywicki, Prime Minister Piekarz, and the rest of the Presidential Cabinet all boarded a private jet bound to Tel Karmiw, telling not a soul of their plans or of the incoming earthquake. The elite of Tallisland merely up and disappeared.

Fighter aircraft requisitioned by the Free Republic of Tallisland quickly sortied to respond to the aircraft, catching it less than a hundred miles from the Sanguivallis border-only a few miles away from freedom. When the jet refused to identity itself or it's passengers, the Free Republic fighters engaged, firing two missiles into the engines.

When Free Republic soldiers arrived via truck to the crash, they quickly learned of the nature of the aircraft, and executed each of the Presidential Guard that survived one by one, until the President and his followers were defenseless. Many of the rebels took turns posing in photographs with the members of government, before executing them as well.

The crash, and the corpses that littered it, were simply left there and the Free Republic continued it's offensive toward Osliburne.

With the President and his Loyalists officially dead now, Finley Gallagher claimed the title of President, as did the legal successor High War-Priest Wojciech Saebaldr. By December 9th, there were five independent factions now fighting for control of Tallisland.

And then the earthquake hit.

A category 7.7. One of the largest in Elseyran history, and doubtlessly the largest in Tallislandic history. It ravaged the already freezing west of the nation, and the severed heat and electric lines cost the lives of hundreds at least. The chaos spurred further instability, culminating in the death of rebel-leader and icon Kjersti Stennes on the 11th.

Patriarch Błoński had refused to evacuate the nation alongside the man that had appointed him to be his ally, Clifford Prisk. Błoński believed that Prisk's sins were finally catching up to him, and that his abandonment of the faithful in Tallisland was an action he could no longer support. As such, he and the Church remained in Evraibal through the earthquake. 

On December 12, Błoński declared himself High Patriarch of the Lusandric Faith, a title unused since the grand prophet Luzandrich spread the gospel to what is now Tallisland. He was using a pre-Republic title to declare the Republic void, that since nobody could agree on who the President was that he held the power to seize both positions.

High Patriarch Błoński now ordered all Lusandric faithfuls in Tallisland to return to Evraibal, both to help and be helped in the wake of the earthquake. 

With the rebellion now in shambles and split among hopefuls, radicals, visionaries and satanists, true anarchy had befell Tallisland. Even those that weren't aggressive before turned into murderous bandits after the earthquake, but they knew that the oppressive Lusandrics couldn't be allowed to strengthen their position.

A group of rebels subscribing to an ethno-nationalist subsection of Young Tallisland prepared thousands of samples of mixed mustard gas and VX, preparing to unleash it on east Tallisland to decimate any remaining government forces, and force the Lusandrics to suffer an equal fate as they had suffered from the earthquake.

Christmas Eve is when the attack began, designed to target the weaker children and gathered crowds of individuals that would celebrate for the Birth of Christ. Gas bombs were detonated in Nowy Białton and Bramptonik, intended to spread downwind and along the flat plains of east Tallisland. Thousands died before the Church was able to begin distribution of masks, disinfectants, and medical supplies to civilians.

Finally, High Patriarch Błoński ordered for the hasty construction of a wall to protect the faithful around Evraibal, and to keep out bandits and warlords that now ran rampant in the anarchy of Tallisland. 

As for the regent of the Szbulbans, Emperor of the White Sea, Admiral Augustus Sikorski, he would be killed by overexposure to VX, dying alongside many Lusandric Faithfuls who had lost their lives distributing medicines and antidotes to civilians.

Tallisland had fallen, it's Church had seized a portion of the country and walled off the rest. A developed nation reduced to this was pitiful on the Elseyran continent. Those that lived through the civil war chose a new lifestyle: living in the hellhole that was former Tallisland, devoting themselves to a Lusandric lifestyle in the Church territory, or leaving the country entirely.

The Szbulban fleet however didn't truly fit into any of these categories, but they found soon of a group of individuals taking over islands in Kianzhou that held similar beliefs to that of their once-great Szbulba. So Sikorski's orphaned fleet wandered themselves across the Nestor Sea, soon enough finding allies in a people named the Fjordorans, agreeing to a confederacy with the people alongside their 56 ships.

Tel Karmiw remained with the church, though the mass chaos in Tallisland sparked a sense of resistance in the people there too. Mass Pan-Shamatist protests began across the nation, and High Patriarch Błoński was already in too poor of a position to begin a long-range conflict against the Karmiwan people. Thus, he invited a representative from nearby [nation=long+noflag]Tan Srpka[/nation] to transfer the island to the more Pan-Shamatist-friendly regime of Alaqar.

[spoiler=[b]The Gythenan Revolution[/b]][b]The Gythenan Revolution[/b]

The struggle had been great, but brief. It seemed only like moments ago that MROS Dynamics convened briefly with the rioters of Polijamsa to discuss the exact navigation of their uprising against the declining government, and now these same "rioters" were in the highest seats of power, having totally and utterly routed the people's enemy in a series of bloodless marches. The soldiers deserted in droves, having lost weeks' worth of wages during the collapse of central authority, never mind basic logistics systems to guide them to where they needed to be at the moment of most urgent crisis. Entire rows of military checkpoints were left unguarded, some still preemptively flew the red flag kilometers before the Gythenan Red Guards were even due to arrive.

Loyalist forces called it a "strategic repositioning" in order to "address the current military situation", but the generals boarded on airliners while the soldiers walked on foot on on civilian trucks, leaving behind unused supply depots and well-supplied warehouses. Where does the resistance go when those who withdraw don't even bring along their guns and ammunition? To oblivion. On the 1st of November, there were maybe around four infantry brigades of the Gythenan Army who pledged to fight against the revolution. By the 1st of December, the last company from the Old Order had peacefully surrendered themselves after realizing that it was all over.

The Peitjad tribes of the coastal north and the moderates in Eluoja were the [i]de facto[/i] last to submit to the New Order, not because of some stiff and brutal resistance, but because they opened negotiations, seeking clarity and understanding of what role they were to play in the New Order. On 11 December 2026, even these stakeholders would finally accede to the revolution and form their own soviets, definitively bringing the entire nation under the control of the New Order.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Red Gythena[/b]][b]Red Gythena[/b]

With the defeat of the counterrevolution, the Gythenan state would be immediately transformed, all preceding institutions abolished and supplanted by the institutions founded during the violence. The Gythenan soviets replaced the municipalities and cities, the Supreme Soviet replaced the Two Councils, while the Red Guards would take over the objectives of the Gythenan Armed Forces, formally renaming itself the Gythenan Soviet Armed Forces. Furthermore, all extant political parties within the country would be dissolved and their assets transferred to a new political organization, [i]Uuden järjestyksen liike[/i] ("Movement of the New Order") or UJL, to act as a uniting society of the most class-conscious members of Gythenan society.

The office of the president and the prime minister would be abolished, while the ministers themselves would be elevated and trasformed into people's commissars, tasked with overseeing the various departments and offices of the state. As for the Two Councils, they would be supplanted as stated by a Supreme Soviet, a unifying congress of all Gythenan soviets to organize the nation's five-year plans, land use frameworks, military doctrines, and economic strategy. The [i]Kansankomissaarien neuvosto[/i] (KKN) or Council of People's Commissars, therefore, is to act as the executive extension of the Supreme Soviet, enforcing its laws and directives whenever it can. Failure to do so empowers the Supreme Soviet to order recalls to select new people's commissars in their stead.

Under Irja Evesti's direction, the following people's commissiariats and commissions would be created for the KKN, all staffed by members of the UJL:

Similar to conventional ministers, the people's commissars acted as subsections of an executive, assembled by a legislature manifest in the form of the Supreme Soviet. Dissimilar to conventional ministers, however, the people's commissars all came from a single political party, the Movement of the New Order, and were not managed by a singular head of state or government. Nominally, idealistically, this entire Council of People's Commissars would be a collective head of government, a directory with control over various aspects of Gythenan society. However, as with most communist governments in history, power in this structure would naturally gravitate to a specific office, that of the Commission for Central Planning (nicknamed [i]Keskus[/i]), which was to act as the nation's statistical bureau and central planning authority. Irja Evesti, therefore, would become the nation's paramount leader.

A ceremonial "President of Gythena" would also be established, though it neither maintained any ceremonial reserve powers typical of a head of state, nor formal controls over state agenda as in a head of government. The office was not even tied to the Council of People's Commissars or the Supreme Soviet, and would instead function as a sort of "floating" office modeled after the office of the President of Qianxun, used largely for diplomatic purposes. Dr. Kustaa Autioniemi, one of the original [i]Kommunardit[/i] who helped managed the Polijamsa Commune, would be named as the first holder of this office in recognition of his efforts towards building a communist society.

Within the day, various subsections of the Red Guards would be converted to regular forces of the Gythenan Soviet Armed Forces or the Internal Troops, else irregulars and paramilitary gendarmes in the Gythenan Extraordinary Committee (better known as the Gythenan Cheka). Eduard Moncur de Waal, an infantry captain and Red Guardsman who aided Ulf de Mayne's capture of Häliskirk, would be placed in control of most military forces as both the People's Commissar for War and Chair of the Gythenan Cheka.

Various political parties and societies would be swiftly suppressed under the Chekists, in particular the Liberal Party and the Conservative Party, Gythena's two largest political parties up to this point, who would be ordered to turn over all its assets to the state, instigating an exodus of anti-communist Gythenans, with many asking for asylum status in various states such as the Neue Republik and the Jomslandic Commonwealth. Many Eisdeutsch noblemen rejecting the system of soviets would even go so far as to form their own militias with the intent of overthrowing the communist leadership. Though, with public opinion currently widely in favor of undertaking the soviet experiment, dissident numbers would be low.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]New Order economics[/b]][b]New Order economics[/b]

The Gythenan economy had contracted by nearly 2% in 2025 thanks to the Gythenan crisis. Now, however, with all economic apparatuses having been restored through the installation of the New Order, projections for the nation in 2026 would be swiftly revised, with some analysts predicting as much as a 6% growth rate in GDP following the sudden opening of Gythenan markets to investments from the Socialist International, Thyven, and the Vespurian Empire. More conservative estimates placed by Keskus, however, would set projections of growth at around 3.4% to account for restrictions set forth by the nation's newly-instituted system of soviets.

Under Evesti's model, the Commonwealth Bank was to serve as the national investment bank of the nation, tasked with a host of objectives to maintain the soviets, which as of the moment were in a transitional state, having been converted from conventional corporations to self-managed workers' cooperatives that still respond to market pressures. One of the tasks of the Commonwealth Bank was to process loans to help found any new soviets deemed necessary for Gythena's five-year plans.

With the crisis slowly dying down in Gythena, the Supreme Soviet would suspend the majority of its localized arms manufacturing facilities, which up to this point had been working on outdated weapons systems such as the Panssari XIII. Instead, in light of the country's important role as the northeastern sector of the Socialist International, Keskus would authorize massive pipelines to begin construction in the country's Arctic area of responsibility, with contracts being swiftly handed out to Almstedt Corporation and Somare S.p.A. to ensure appropriate timescales.

Other critical sectors such as water, education, healthcare, electricity, and agriculture would be immediately nationalized and collectivized under New Order socialism's policy practices. Agricultural farms in particular would be merged into large "agro-cities" aimed at promoting sustainable agroforestry and mixed-use development. Some analysts would consider these policies a possible reaction to the "Old Order socialism" of the 1900s, which prioritized smaller-scale agricultural soviets engaged in high-yield, monocultural farming to meet government quotas. 

Though considered theoretically sound, hardliners within the UJL would criticize the agro-city concept as a "right tendency" that necessitated a two-tier system of workers due to their sizes, one kind that was elite and practiced labor management, and the other that constituted the "true" proletariat, who still received exploitative wages for their labor input. In a brief treatise, the UJL regarded the agro-cities as a "transitional concept", still reliance on large bureaucratic firms, and which they seek to dissolve into smaller scale, self-sustaining communes in the later future.

However, hardliners within the UJL would nevertheless bemoan these economic adjustments as a formal acceptance of the two-stage model of socialism and the acceptance of bourgeois mechanism in the proletarian revolution. Evesti and allies, however, would disagree, indicating that the Gythenan soviets were at least unique in its use of workers' self-management compared to the Sanguinian and Qianxun megacorporations, which operated under conventional corporate hierarchies that were far more prone to recede back into "the anarchy of capitalism".[/spoiler]

[nation]Baladullah[/nation]
